theorem mvcc.reader_prefix_from (log₀ ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hcmp : mvcc.histOf
    log₀ <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend ∨ mvcc.histShape ilog pend <+: mvcc.histOf log₀) (hcount :
    (mvcc.evsOf log₀).length ≤ (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^
    63) : ∃ rest, mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend]) = mvcc.evsOf log₀ ++ rest ∧ ∀ (e : mvcc.Ev), e ∈ rest
    → ↑(List.length log₀) ≤ sint.Z e.rev.main

theorem mvcc.reader_avail (log₀ ilog : mvcc.Log) (pend : List mvcc.Change) (hcmp : mvcc.histOf log₀
    <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend ∨ mvcc.histShape ilog pend <+: mvcc.histOf log₀) (hcount :
    (mvcc.evsOf log₀).length ≤ (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])).length) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^
    63) (hb0 : mvcc.LogB log₀) (k : GoString) (c : Int) (hc0 : -1 ≤ c) (hc : c < ↑(List.length
    log₀)) : mvcc.kiAvail (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) k) = mvcc.kiAvail (W64
    c) (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log₀) k)

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.keep_some {cmax : Int} {log : mvcc.Log} (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {idx :
    mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (rev : w64) (hc : cmax ≤ sint.Z rev)
    {k : GoString} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hg : mvcc.idxGet idx k = some ki) : mvcc.kiKeep rev ki =
    mvcc.kiKeep rev (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log) k)

theorem mvcc.kiKeep_keepOf (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiKeep c ki = mvcc.keepOf c
    (ki.gens.getD (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens) mvcc.Gen.empty) (mvcc.compactGenIdx c ki.gens =
    ki.gens.length - 1)

theorem mvcc.keepOf_cutGen (c c' : w64) (hcc : sint.Z c ≤ sint.Z c') (g : mvcc.Gen) (l : Prop)
    [Decidable l] : mvcc.keepOf c' (mvcc.cutGen c g) l = mvcc.keepOf c' g l

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.keep_none {cmax : Int} {log : mvcc.Log} (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {idx :

    {k : GoString} (hg : mvcc.idxGet idx k = none) : mvcc.kiKeep rev (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log)
    k) = none

theorem mvcc.idxGet_congr {idx idx' : mvcc.IndexM} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) (hs' :
    List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx') {k' : GoString} (h : ∀ (v : mvcc.KeyIndex), (k', v) ∈ idx' ↔
    (k', v) ∈ idx) : mvcc.idxGet idx' k' = mvcc.idxGet idx k'

theorem mvcc.kiAvail_isEmpty {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (h : mvcc.kiIsEmpty ki = true) (c : w64) :
    mvcc.kiAvail c ki = none

theorem mvcc.keepOf_genPut_last (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) (rev : mvcc.Rev) (hc : sint.Z c < sint.Z
    rev.main) (l : Prop) [Decidable l] (hl : l) : mvcc.keepOf c (mvcc.genPut g rev) l = mvcc.keepOf
    c g l

theorem mvcc.kiRevs_kiOfKey {evs : List mvcc.Ev} {k : GoString} {r : mvcc.Rev} (h : r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs
    (mvcc.kiOfKey evs k)) : ∃ e, e ∈ evs ∧ e.rev = r ∧ e.key = k

theorem mvcc.kiKeep_fold (c : w64) (k : GoString) (B : List mvcc.Ev) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) :
    mvcc.KiWf ki → (∀ (e : mvcc.Ev), e ∈ B → sint.Z c < sint.Z e.rev.main) → mvcc.kiKeep c
    (mvcc.kiFold ki B k) = mvcc.kiKeep c ki

theorem mvcc.kiRevs_kiCompact {c : w64} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} {r : mvcc.Rev} (h : r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs
    (mvcc.kiCompact c ki)) : r ∈ mvcc.kiRevs ki

def mvcc.keepOf (c : w64) (g : mvcc.Gen) (last : Prop) [Decidable last] : Option mvcc.Rev :=
  have ri := mvcc.genWalk g.revs (mvcc.pAbove c);
  if ri = -1 then none
  else if g.revs ≠ [] ∧ ri = ↑(g.revs.length - 1) ∧ ¬last then none else some (g.revs.getD ri.toNat mvcc.Rev.zero)

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.avail_none {cmax : Int} {log : mvcc.Log} (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {idx :
    mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (c : Int) (hc : cmax ≤ c) (hc' : c < 2
    ^ 63) {k : GoString} (hg : mvcc.idxGet idx k = none) : mvcc.kiAvail (W64 c) (mvcc.kiOfKey
    (mvcc.evsOf log) k) = none

theorem mvcc.kiKeep_kiTombstone {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c : w64) (rev : mvcc.Rev)
    (hc : sint.Z c < sint.Z rev.main) : mvcc.kiKeep c (mvcc.kiTombstone ki rev) = mvcc.kiKeep c ki

theorem mvcc.kiKeep_eq (c : w64) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) : mvcc.kiKeep c ki = none ∨ mvcc.kiKeep c ki =
    mvcc.kiAvail c ki

theorem mvcc.kiKeep_kiCompact_S {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hwf : mvcc.KiWf ki) (c c' : w64) (hcc : sint.Z
    c ≤ sint.Z c') : mvcc.kiKeep c' (mvcc.kiCompact c ki) = mvcc.kiKeep c' ki

    <+: mvcc.histShape ilog pend ∨ mvcc.histShape ilog pend <+: mvcc.histOf log₀) (hcount :

    63) (hb0 : mvcc.LogB log₀) (k : GoString) (rev : w64) (h0 : 0 ≤ sint.Z rev) (hrev : sint.Z rev <
    ↑(List.length log₀)) : mvcc.kiKeep rev (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf (ilog ++ [pend])) k) =
    mvcc.kiKeep rev (mvcc.kiOfKey (mvcc.evsOf log₀) k)

    ↔ l') : mvcc.keepOf c g l = mvcc.keepOf c g l'

    c ki).gens ≠ [] ∧ ∀ (i : Nat), i + 1 < (mvcc.kiCompact c ki).gens.length → ((mvcc.kiCompact c
    ki).gens.getD i mvcc.Gen.empty).revs ≠ []

theorem mvcc.idx_key_unique {idx : mvcc.IndexM} (hs : List.Pairwise mvcc.idxLess idx) {i j : Nat} {a
    b : GoString × mvcc.KeyIndex} (hi : idx[i]? = some a) (hj : idx[j]? = some b) (hk : a.fst =
    b.fst) : i = j

theorem mvcc.keepOf.congr_simp (c c✝ : w64) (e_c : c = c✝) (g g✝ : mvcc.Gen) (e_g : g = g✝) (last
    last✝ : Prop) (e_last : last = last✝) {inst✝ : Decidable last} [Decidable last✝] : mvcc.keepOf c
    g last = mvcc.keepOf c✝ g✝ last✝

    mvcc.evsOf log) (h2 : e2 ∈ mvcc.evsOf log) (h : e1.rev = e2.rev) : e1 = e2

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.avail_some {cmax : Int} {log : mvcc.Log} (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {idx :
    mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (c : Int) (hc : cmax ≤ c) (hc' : c < 2
    ^ 63) {k : GoString} {ki : mvcc.KeyIndex} (hg : mvcc.idxGet idx k = some ki) : mvcc.kiAvail (W64

theorem mvcc.IdxCRep.compactAt {cmax c' : Int} {log : mvcc.Log} (hb : mvcc.LogB log) {idx :
    mvcc.IndexM} (h : mvcc.IdxCRep cmax (mvcc.evsOf log) idx) (hle : cmax ≤ c') (hc' : c' < 2 ^ 63)
    (i : Nat) (k : GoString) (ki : mvcc.KeyIndex) (hi : idx[i]? = some (k, ki)) : mvcc.IdxCRep c'
    (mvcc.evsOf log) (if mvcc.kiIsEmpty (mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c') ki) = true then List.eraseIdx idx i
    else List.set idx i (k, mvcc.kiCompact (W64 c') ki))
